title: LocalAI/user.json
description: Who the assistant talks to. A short block of it reaches the model in every chat.

language.title: Language
language.description: A language tag such as en, it or pt-BR.

bio.title: About you
bio.description: A few lines the assistant reads in every chat.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: An IANA time zone such as Europe/Rome.

seen.description: What LocalAI and the assistant showed or offered you, and your answers. The Account page resets it; it is not sent to the model.

home_examples.description: The "Make LocalAI yours" cards on Home: hidden is the date you hid them.

offers_off.description: true: the assistant offers nothing. Absent: the server's default.

new_off.description: true: no "New" label in the sidebar.

since.description: When LocalAI first saw you, for the quiet start.

last_offer.description: When the server last allowed an offer.

offer_turn.description: The chat and turn of the last offer allowed.

offer_chats.description: The last chats where an offer was allowed.

offers.description: Your answer to each kind of offer: profile, shortcut, schedule.

new.description: When each new area (pages) was first labelled New.
